members.name: TEXT_QST_048_BARRELMAN_THANKS_10
members.text: Excellent! Thanks, lad. You've done me a big favour.
members.speaker: WORKER

members.name: TEXT_QST_048_BARRELMAN_THANKS_20
members.text: I'll let your dad know what a splendid watchman you made.
members.speaker: WORKER

members.name: TEXT_QST_048_BARRELMAN_LETDOWN_BROKEN_10
members.text: A fat lot of good you were.
members.speaker: WORKER

members.name: TEXT_QST_048_BARRELMAN_LETDOWN_BROKEN_20
members.text: Now my stock is damaged! And to think I trusted you with it.
members.speaker: WORKER

members.name: TEXT_QST_048_BARRELMAN_LETDOWN_BROKEN_30
members.text: If I find out it was you, well... you better hope I don't!
members.speaker: WORKER

members.name: TEXT_QST_048_BARRELMAN_LETDOWN_NOT_BROKE_10
members.text: Oi! Where did you go, you little ruffian?
members.speaker: WORKER

members.name: TEXT_QST_048_BARRELMAN_LETDOWN_NOT_BROKE_20
members.text: I'm lucky my stock wasn't damaged with nobody watching!
members.speaker: WORKER
